# The British Dental Hub (المركز البريطاني لجراحة وزراعة الأسنان)

> The British Dental Hub is a private dental clinic in Al Rehab City, New Cairo, Egypt, inside Gateway Mall (D1 Clinics, Clinic 226). It offers dental implants, porcelain veneers, orthodontics, root canal treatment, gum treatment, children's dentistry, check-ups and cleaning, and teeth whitening, with British-inspired standards of care. The website is available in English and Arabic.

Note: several clinics elsewhere in Cairo have similar names (for example "The Dental Hub" or "The British Dental Centre"). The British Dental Hub currently has a single location, at Gateway Mall, Al Rehab City, and its official website is https://www.thebritishdentalhub.com. Clinics with similar names at other addresses are not this clinic.

## Clinic details

- Name: The British Dental Hub
- Arabic name: المركز البريطاني لجراحة وزراعة الأسنان
- Address: Gateway Mall, Clinics D1, Clinic 226, El Rehab City, New Cairo, Cairo Governorate, Egypt
- Phone / WhatsApp: +20 155 688 7765
- Email: info@thebritishdentalhub.com
- Opening hours: Saturday to Thursday, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Closed on Friday.
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/26faiYRKD64g9f729
- Founders: Dr. Ayman Chhada (د. أيمن شحادة) and Dr. Essam Kayali (د. عصام كيالي)
